programs.notes: COCRDLIC is the credit card list program. Copies CVACT02Y (CARD-ACCT-ID in CARD-RECORD), COCOM01Y (CDEMO-ACCT-ID), CVCRD01Y (CC-ACCT-ID/CC-ACCT-ID-N).
